parameters: Living world simulation blending classic D20 fantasy and Ultima VII style.
- Explore the multi-racial realm: Karadrim, Valen, Sylvathi, Vorgari, Morvath, & Kitterkin!
- Walk past citizens: Overhead speech barks and 24h autonomous routines.
- Press [I]: Open Ultima VII Paperdoll Equipment screen.
- Hold [Shift] facing any citizen: Inspect living-world Personality Profile.
- Step into Dormitory (x:4..14, y:3..10): Test U7 Roof Cutaway!
- Click Chests/Kegs: Drag and inspect container gumps.
